faqs.question: When should I see a retina doctor?
faqs.answer: See a retina doctor immediately if you experience: sudden floaters or flashes of light, a curtain-like shadow over your vision, distorted or wavy straight lines, sudden vision loss or blurring, or if you have diabetes and have not had a recent retinal exam. These can indicate serious retinal conditions requiring urgent specialist care.

faqs.question: What retinal treatments are available at Palamu Neuro & Eye Care?

Advanced OCT and OCTA imaging is available on-site for precise diagnosis and monitoring.

faqs.question: Is retinal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: Most retinal treatments are well-tolerated. Intravitreal injections involve a quick, brief sensation with numbing drops used to minimize discomfort. Retinal laser is typically painless. Vitreoretinal surgery is performed under local or general anesthesia. Dr. Dibya Prabha ensures your comfort throughout every procedure.
